writeup.headline: Dave rates Buy on very strong quality, a clean balance sheet and fast but slowing growth.
writeup.thesis: Dave scores 71, a Buy, carried mainly by quality (93) and balance sheet (90). It has a free cash flow margin of 50.7%, stock-based pay at 5.8% of revenue and a diluted share count down 6.0% year on year, while net debt is just 0.05 times free cash flow. Growth scores 69 on TTM revenue growth of 48.6% and latest-quarter revenue growth of 29.6% year on year, though growth slowed by 17.1 pp from the previous quarter. Valuation (63) is moderate in absolute terms at 6.9x sales and 13.5x free cash flow, with FCF yield 2.4 pp above the 10-year Treasury yield; against its own history it is near the middle overall, with P/S more expensive than at 34 of the last 44 month-ends.
